question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words underlined in the given sentence.**

I can’t believe that I am doing this __ordinary and dull__ task.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mundane**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**mundane**" means ordinary or dull. (साधारण या नीरस)
 
• It is an adjective that can be used to describe tasks, activities, or situations.
 
• Synonyms for "mundane" include boring, monotonous, and tedious.
 
 
• **Example**: *I'm tired of doing mundane tasks like washing dishes and folding laundry.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Immoral **means not conforming to accepted standards of morality. (नैतिकता के स्वीकृत मानकों के अनुरूप नहीं)
 
• **Tenacious **means persistent or determined. (लगातार या दृढ़ निश्चयी)
 
• **Destitute **means extremely poor or lacking basic necessities. (अत्यंत गरीब या बुनियादी आवश्यकताओं की कमी)
